title: The Thinking Girl
description: Auld Maerwyn pulls the player into the 5-day Seed-Conversion event window targeting Thenna Orys. Hooks into world-event 'seed-conversion-thenna' (see fixtures/event-seed-conversion.json). Soft-fails to end-too-late if the world-event window closes before Beat 4 resolves — modeled here via the seedConversion.thenna.active flag, which the world-event scheduler clears on cleanup.

beats.description: Auld Maerwyn at the Verge edge: 'There's a girl thinking in the Compact house. Thinking at the wrong frequency. Go listen.'

choices.text: Take the hint. Ride for the Compact house.

beats.description: The Compact house in Eastmile. Halven Orys is in the courtyard. Two ways in.

choices.text: Slip in the side door (covert, -25 Compact).

beats.description: Thenna Orys, 17, sits by the window. She speaks in dream-fragments — names a handler ('Calix'), describes a route, calls it 'remembering.'

choices.text: Listen carefully. Extract two of three facts.

beats.description: Thenna's route is real. She walks it tonight unless someone stops her. Three options.

choices.text: Walk her to the Verge for Thornwood placement (requires good intel).
Ambush Calix on the route (combat — Aether-aligned rare encounter).
Tell Halven the truth (requires good intel).
Hesitate. (If the window closes here, the chain soft-fails.)

beats.description: The Singing Brook accepts her. Maerwyn nods. 'Good. Tea.' Permanent +100 Thornwood floor.
Calix bleeds into the road. Thenna is rattled but home. Drest hears about it. Maerwyn: 'Good. Tea? — but the dark leaf today.'
Halven sends Thenna south under escort. Compact closes ranks. Maerwyn is bitter; the Reach is bemused.
The window closes. Thenna walks her route. Three ticks later Halven appears in mourning at the Bent Mare. Maerwyn does not appear.
Player declined. The world-event runs to its failure terminal off-screen. Halven is generous-and-empty for one tick.
